write.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writer.definition: A person who writes, or produces literary work; an author can refer to themselves as "the writer".

writes.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

writing.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

written.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrongly.definition: In violation of a moral or other standard, code, or convention; in an unfair, unjust, dishonest, or immoral manner; wrongly convicted is synonymous with wrongful conviction and miscarriage of justice.

wrote.definition: To form letters, words or symbols on a surface in order to communicate.

wrung.definition: Often followed by out: to squeeze or twist (something moist) tightly so that liquid is forced out.

yard.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yards.definition: A small, usually uncultivated area adjoining or (now especially) within the precincts of a house or other building.

yawned.definition: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.

year.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yearn.definition: To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

yearned.definition: To have a strong desire for something or to do something; to long for or to do something.

years.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

year’s.definition: In, on, or at this place (a place perceived to be close to the speaker); compare there.

yellow.definition: The color of sunflower petals and lemons; the color obtained by mixing green and red light, or by subtracting blue from white light; the color evoked by light of wavelength around 580 nm; one of the three primary colors in subtractive color systems.

yes.definition: An affirmative expression; an answer that shows agreement or acceptance.

yesterday.definition: The day immediately before today; one day ago.

yet.definition: Thus far; up to the present; up to some unspecified time.

yield.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielded.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yielding.definition: To give as a result or outcome; to produce or render.

yoke.definition: The yellow, spherical part of an egg that is surrounded by the white albumen, and serves as nutriment for the growing young.

yonder.definition: At or in a distant but indicated place.

you.definition: To address (a person) using the pronoun you (in the past, especially to use you rather than thou, when you was considered more formal).

young.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youngest.definition: In the early part of growth or life; born not long ago.

youth.definition: The quality or state of being young.

youths.definition: The quality or state of being young.

zeal.definition: The fervour or tireless devotion for a person, cause, or ideal and determination in its furtherance; diligent enthusiasm; powerful interest.
